method: BASELINE. scope: From the seat of the employee-author and the founder: s 10(1) (computer program, literary work, work), ss 22(1), 29A, 32 (subsistence), s 35 (ownership: author, periodical employees, commissioned photographs/portraits/engravings, employees under a contract of service, agreements to the contrary), s 31 (exclusive rights, incl. rental of programs), ss 36(1), 47B (infringement; running a copy), ss 33, 80 (duration), ss 196, 197 (assignment in writing signed by the assignor; future copyright), Part IX ss 189-195AX so far as the employee-author needs (moral rights, duration, who enforces, written and employee blanket consent, attribution).
